question.text: The 'Best Practices for Portfolio Managers' (issued by APMI) are:

answer.text: Voluntary industry-adopted standards for conduct, disclosure, and governance

explanation.text: The Logic: Best Practices = APMI voluntary standards, industry-adopted to raise governance. Complement (don't replace) SEBI PM Regs. The Trap: They aren't mandatory — but most reputable PMs follow them for industry standing. Cross-Exam Context: NEW for XXI-B vs XXI-A (XXI-A uses Code of Conduct for Distributors). Manager's Pro-Tip: Adherence to Best Practices signals maturity to institutional clients — list compliance in DDQ responses and pitch decks.
